data.name: Nessi
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nessi was the goddess of the forest, associated with fertility and protection. She was often depicted as a snake or a woman with the upper body of a snake.

in_hebrew.name: נסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hebrew name meaning 'one who escapes, or is rescued from danger, associated with the word 'nes', meaning 'to escape, to be delivered'

in_latin.name: Nessi
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin name possibly derived from the Greek word 'νέσσος' (nēssos) meaning 'new', or from 'NESSUS', a centaur in Greek mythology

in_english.name: Nessi
in_english.long_meaning: English name derived from Hebrew 'נסי' (Nessi) or possibly the Greek 'Νέσσι' (Nessi)

data.cultural_impact: The name Nessi may evoke associations with the Greek goddess Nessus, particularly her connection to the forest and natural beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Nessi may symbolize a deep connection to nature and the divine feminine, embodying qualities of protection, fertility, and transformation. As Nessus was also associated with the underworld and redemption in some mythologies, this name could also carry a deeper spiritual significance, representing a journey towards healing, purification, and rebirth.
